name: Section
summary: A titled part of a page: a heading, a short intro that holds for everything in it, then its content. Not for the page's own head (use PageHeader) or for grouping that space alone already shows.
a11y: Renders `section`, named by its heading through `aria-labelledby` when it has one. The heading level follows the outline, never the visual size. An index numeral is decorative.

props.name: heading
props.description: Names the section; the section is labelled by it.

props.name: level
props.description: Semantic level from the page outline.

props.name: intro
props.description: One or two sentences that hold for everything in the section, on a shorter line than running text.

props.name: index
props.description: A number shown large in its own column beside the section, for a numbered sequence such as tiers. Hidden from assistive technology: the heading carries the meaning.

props.name: nested
props.description: A section inside another section's content: its parts sit closer, so it reads as one group of the outer section.

props.name: headingData
props.description: `data-*` attributes for the heading, for tooling such as revision anchors.
